strict: Default unchanged; no trial grant consumed by strict semantic qualification; old frozen requests unchanged.
supervised: Native author policy scopes Book/task/Producer/candidate/revision/expiry/tokens/amount; only literary benchmark/quality insufficiency may be overridden.

cross_review.identity: exact generator Effect + target version/hash; no prompt/account substitution
cross_review.purpose: AUTHOR_ADVISORY only; no independent qualification rows
cross_review.decision: Author must resolve or evidence-dismiss each exact non-PASS finding before native approval. Auto author substitution disabled.

asset_source: Three diagnostic samples retain BENCHMARK_ONLY. Author input is original and truthfully attributed; Formation v3 consumes its exact approved version.
recovery: Unknown network outcomes reuse original request/key; confirmed policy CAS failure retained then reconfirmed against refreshed policy; plan rejection reuses original expected version.
